function: Fit-check coupon: two kite ribs that drop into the Apollo fan's tapered base slots; verifies the connector before the full tripod sled

fits.feature: kite rib into tapered base slot

principal_load: negligible; hand insertion/removal, lateral nudges in XY
assumptions: slot width at its very front end is 4.0 mm (not yet measured)
fan base plane is flat and co-planar across label platform and foot recesses
slot walls are vertical (no draft measured)
